relations.subject: Namkhai Norbu
relations.evidence: Namkhai Norbu Rinpoche is a Tibetan lama who, from 1964 to the present, has been a professor at the Istituto Orientale, University of Naples, Italy, where he teaches Tibetan language, Mongolian language, and Tibetan cultural history.

relations.subject: Namkhai Norbu
relations.object: Southwestern University of Minor Nationalities at Chengdu
relations.evidence: From 1954 he was an instructor in Tibetan language at the Southwestern University of Minor Nationalities at Chengdu, Sichuan, China.

relations.evidence: While living in China, he met the famous Gangs dkar Rinpoche. From the master he heard many explanations of the Six Doctrines of Naropa, Mahāmudrā, the dKon mchog spyi 'dus, as well as Tibetan medicine.
